exit_code_note: 128+9 = SIGKILL. Third distinct kill signal observed: 137=SIGKILL (OS/external force), 143=SIGTERM (external graceful), 144=watchdog breach. Watchdog logged the breach at 15.0 GB swap delta during warmup, then the process was SIGKILL'd — possibly the OS OOM killer stepping in on top of the Python watchdog.

breach_details.interpretation: Started with 33 GB free. Model load took 9.3s (normal). Warmup started at 21:15:58, breach at 21:16:23 — 25 seconds into warmup. Something consumed ~20 GB between baseline capture and warmup. Likely another model or process loaded concurrently (the engineer was iterating on SnapKV with uncommitted WIP in hypercar_server.py and snapkv.py — they may have started a test run from the terminal right as the analyst bench started its warmup).

new_observation_leaked_semaphore: resource_tracker: leaked semaphore /mp-e666laq9 at shutdown. From the profiler or watchdog subprocess multiprocessing. Not a data issue but worth noting — indicates the watchdog subprocess didn't clean up its semaphore before the SIGKILL.
